title: Media: Audio, Video, Embeds

sections.content: HTML embeds rich media natively: for images,
Always provide fallback content inside media tags for older browsers, and include controls + preload hints on video/audio.
Key points: lazy-loading images (loading="lazy") speeds pages, iframes need sandboxing for security, and video needs multiple formats for compatibility.

sections.codeExample:
<video controls preload="metadata">
    <source src="clip.mp4" type="video/mp4">
    Your browser does not support video.
</video>
